restated_recommendation: Ensure that CAs carry out verification of compliance with product specifications effectively, in order to comply with Articles 36 and 37 of Regulation (EU) No 1151/2012. Date of last edit:
response: CAFIA in its internal regulation related to official inspections of PDO/PGI/TSG distinguishes between two types of official inspections. The first called "verification of compliance with the product specification before placing the product on the market" relates to Article 37 of Regulation (EU) No. 1151/2012. Within this type of official inspection, compliance with all parameters of the specification is verified. The second one is called "check of observance of specification requirements" and within this inspection, the inspectors carry out inspection of selected products based on the risk analysis. On the branch meeting focused on the matter of PDO/PGI/TSG, the inspectors will be instructed to carry out check of all parameters of the specification when checking selected products at the producer within the "check of observance of specification requirements". This aspect was incorporated into the internal regulation of CAFIA related to official inspections of PDO/PGI/TSG applicable since 1. 8. 2013. Page: 1

restated_recommendation: To ensure that staff carrying out official controls have access to an adequate laboratory capacity for testing as required by Article 4 of Regulation (EC) No 882/2004, notably to reduce the turnaround times for analysing feed samples for undesirable substances and to ensure that the screening methods used are able to detect all coccidiostats used in Denmark.
response: The reorganisation of the laboratory service has had an influence on the turnaround time in 2012 and partly in 2013. The analytical control of feed is now carried out at two laboratories, which guarantee that the capacity is adequate. In order to reduce the costs for the business operators, the analytical control is now organised so that the samples normally will be analysed in full series and not necessary on the day of arrival. This can prolong the turnaround time. The laboratory is also working on a new organisation of the sampling, which will reduce the turnaround time. Concerning screening methods for coccidiostats used in Denmark the situation in 2012 was that monensin, lasalocid, salinomycin and narasin/nicarbazin were used (Informations from Vetstat). The LC/MS screening method is able to detect these substances except nicarbazin. This substance is only used in Denmark when mixed with narasin 1:1. So when we analyze for carry-over of narasin, we also analyse indirectly for nicarbazin.

restated_recommendation: To ensure in accordance with EU legal requirements on control of epizootic diseases that CPs allow access to facilities, equipment, personnel and all other appropriate materials necessary for the rapid and efficient eradication of a geographically widespread epizootic disease outbreak.
response: The means available for allowing access to facilities etc. are legal powers and deals and contracts with authorities and companies. The legal powers, through the Epizootic Diseases Act, are far reaching. According to 9 § in this act the SBA has the power to decide the following: - Proprietors of slaughter houses and other facilities handling different types of products and animal bi- products have to make these facilities and their equipment and personnel available for any needs in case of an outbreak of epizootic disease. - Proprietors of tools and equipment essential in case of an outbreak of an epizootic disease must provide this when needed during an outbreak. CPs by themselves are not legal acts, but refer to relevant legislation. CPs provide detailed information concerning facilities, equipment and personnel. The CPs will be updated within the SBA project on contingency planning to ensure even more detailed information. The project is running 2013-2015, (see draft report of the audit 5.2.1 last paragraph). A letter of intent has been set up between the Nordic and Baltic countries, in which personnel and equipment may be available from neighbouring countries.

response: Uudessa tämän vuoden syksyllä eduskunnan käsittelyyn tulevassa sivutuotelaissa on tarkennettu viranomaisen rekisteröintitoimivaltaan liittyneitä puutteita. Lakiesityksessä on annettu Elintarviketurvallisuusviraston tehtäväksi rekisteröidä välittäjät, jotka toimivat yksinomaan jälleenmyyjinä eivätkä missään vaiheessa säilytä tuotteita tiloissaan. Elintarviketurvallisuusviraston tehtävänä olisi myös isteröidä kuljetusliikkeet. Kuitenkin kaatopaikolle tai polttolaitoksiin tteenä hävitettäviä sivutuotteita kuljettavat toimijat ja kompostointi tai biokaasulaitoksiin sivutuotteita kuljettavat toimijat rekisteröidään ympäristöhallinnon ylläpitämään jätehuoltorekisteriin. Eviralla olisi ekisteriin tiedonsaantioikeus. Kun viranomaiselle annetaan toimivalta edellä mainittujen toimijoiden rekisteröintiin, voidaan ne myös huomioida valvontaohjeissa ja valvontasuunnitelmassa ja sisällyttää toimijaluetteloon.

The CAs should ensure that inspectors carrying out official controls on fishery products are adequately trained in line with Article 6 (a) of Regulation (EC) No 882/2004.

The CAs should have procedures in place to ensure the effectiveness of official controls of fishery products at all stages of production, including primary production in accordance with the requirements laid down in Article 4.2 (a) Article 8.3 (a) of Regulation (EC) No 882/2004.

The CAs should take measures in order to ensure that the official controls carried out based on Article 4(2) of Regulation (EC) No 854/2004 are able to verify that the requirements of Article 4(1) of Regulation (EC) No 852/2004 and Article 3 of Regulation (EC) No 853/2004 are met in fishing vessels and aquaculture farms. In particular they should ensure that documented procedures (checklists) used by the federal states during official controls in primary production, are sufficiently detailed to enable the relevant requirements to be assessed adequately during official controls.

The CA should ensure that FBOs implement and maintain procedures based on HACCP principles that fully comply with Article 5 of Regulation (EC) No 852/2004. In particular, that all relevant potential hazards are identified and monitoring and verification procedures are adequately implemented for CCPs.

The CA should provide guarantees that fishery products placed on the EU market have been handled in establishments approved according to Regulation (EC) No 853/2004. These guarantees in particular should cover reefer vessels transporting and storing bulk frozen fishery products in their own temperature controlled holds or rooms.

response: , Der Ausbruch wurde im November 2013 entdeckt. Umgehend wurde ein intensives Monitoring, auch mit Baumkletterern und rhunden, gestartet und es wurden bisher 113 befallene Bäume he festgestellt. Alle befallenen Bäume wurden gefällt, verhäckselt und das Material verbrannt. Der Befall scheint sich im Ortszentrum (wo die Granitsteine verarbeitet wurden) zu konzentrieren, sodass in einem ersten Schritt als Befallsgebiet ein Kreis mit einem Radius von 1000 m und als Pufferzone ein Kreis mit einem Radius von 2000 m um das Ortszentrum definiert wurde. Es war immer das klare Ziel, die Pufferzone zu erweitern, sobald das genaue Ausmaß des Befalles bekannt ist. Wenn die Feststellung des genauen Befallsausmaßes in der Befallszone abgeschlossen ist wird, ausgehend von den Grenzen der Befallszone, eine neue Pufferzone mit einem Mindestradius von 2000 m festgelegt.

response: ble, Auch präventive Fällungen im öffentlichen Bereich, vor allem in f Bereichen in denen die Überwachung schwierig ist, wurden durchgeführt. t Präventivfällungen als Eingriff in das Eigentumsrecht dürfen nur of mit Zustimmung des Eigentümers und nur nach ausdrücklichen gesetzlichen Vorgaben durchgeführt werden. Das Grundrecht auf Unverletzlichkeit des Eigentums ist dabei zu wahren (siehe z.B. auch Artikel 17 der Grundrechtscharta der Europäischen Union). Ein Eingriff in das Eigentumsrecht ist daher nur bei überwiegendem öffentlichem Interesse, sowie gegen angemessene Entschädigung erlaubt, wobei stets das gelindeste noch zum Ziel führende Mittel anzuwenden ist. Präventivfällungen ohne Zustimmung des Eigentümers dürfen demnach nur nach einem formellen Verfahren, das einer gerichtlichen Überprüfung unterliegt, durchgeführt werden. Es können somit auf Privatgrund Fälle auftreten, bei denen eine Präventivfällung asymptomatischer Bäume nicht gerechtfertigt oder möglich ist und beispielsweise durch ein besonders intensives Monitoring zu ersetzen ist. restated_recommendation: To ensure that the dehorning of calves is authorised on a case by case basis by the competent authorities, as required by Article 18(1) of Regulation (EC) No 889/2008. Recommendation based on conclusion: 44 Associated finding: 43
response: The Swedish Board of Agriculture interpret article 18(1) of Regulation (EC) No 889/2008 as there is no obligation for a case- by-case allowance for dehorning for security reasons. The Swedish version of the regulation is clear regarding that case-by- case authorisation is only required for mutilations intended to improve health, welfare or hygiene. The Swedish linguistic version is legally binding in Sweden. It is also logic, since the security risk with horns is known in advance for all farms. According to Swedish animal welfare legislation, calves younger than eight weeks may be disbudded. This is done for security reasons for workers safety and for animal protection, especially for dairy cows in loose house systems. Dehorning of animals with horns is not practiced in Sweden. We see no reason not to allow disbudding, given that the animal welfare legislation is respected and that no polled animals are available. It would therefore be disproportional to create an administrative burden for farmers by introducing individual authorisation.

Since ice used for chilling fish is not incorporated into the fish it is not food, and companies producing ice solely for this purpose are not a food businesses. Folgende Maßnahmen werden dazu ergriffen: - Die Antragsqualität wird durch die ­ bereits erfolgte ­ Einführung einer qualifizierten Vorprüfung deutlich erhöht. Zudem wird die Bearbeitung der Anträge in den beteiligten Bewertungsbehörden noch stärker synchronisiert. - Die Möglichkeit der Vorlage von zusätzlichen Studien wird nach einer erstmaligen vollständigen Bewertung auf einen Zeitpunkt innerhalb von 6 Monaten begrenzt. - Nicht prüffähige Anträge und solche, deren negative Bewertung selbst nach Vorlage neuer Daten weiterhin fortbesteht und sich auch durch Risikominderungsmaßnahmen nicht ausräumen lässt, werden zügig abgewiesen. - Für abgelehnte Anträge mit behebbaren Mängeln wird die Durchführung eines vereinfachten Anschlussverfahrens geprüft. - Eine Optimierung der Zusammenarbeit der Behörden untereinander soll dafür sorgen, dass Zulassungsentscheidungen zügig getroffen werden. - Die Abläufe in Zulassungsverfahren werden mit dem Ziel der Prozesso

Recommendation based on conclusion set out in paragraph No 37. Associated finding set out in paragraph No 29
response: The Veterinary and Food Safety Directorate will amend and update existing procedure for approval of establishments dealing (EC) with food of animal origin. The procedure will be amended and updated by the end of April 2017. Furthermore, whenever there is a request for approval of larger establishments and those who carry out complex, higher risk operations as part of their business which is being approved, the approval committee, besides local competent inspectors, consists of senior veterinary inspector from the central level in charge of food controls (Veterinary Inspection Department). The Veterinary and Food Safety Directorate will draft new procedure for official controls performed by senior veterinary inspectors from the central level. The procedure will facilitate the increase of quality and consistency of official controls at all levels thus ensuring uniform performance of veterinary inspectors, including official controls during approval process. The procedure will be drafted by the end of April 2017.

response: The Dutch authorities disagrees with the finding and mmendation to notify OF/SI containing PAP consignments in intracommunity trade. We do not see any legal requirement in the ABP regulation to substantiate this recommendation. The wording of the article 48.3 of Regulation (EU) no. 1069/2009 clearly states that "PAP derived from category 3 material" needs a notification via TRACES by the MS of origin. There is no mention of "and products containing PAP" as is done in other parts of the Regulation when it is the intention of the legislator to include not 100% pure products. This interpretation is supported by the majority of MS as confirmed during the working group on ABP of 15 October 2018.

response: FASFC already has provisions in place for what constitutes "significant" changes in the activities of FBOs. The FASFC has established an activity list (activities sheets including approval conditions) which is available on the FASFC website. Certain risks have been taken into account when establishing this list. A change of activities (i.e. the starting of a new activity in the list) constitutes a significant change within the meaning of Article 6(2) of Regulation (EC) No 852/2004 and thus needs notification to the FASFC and, if applicable, approval. The draft report insinuates that a switch from producing cheese from pasteurized milk to raw milk cheese should constitute a significant change within the meaning of Article 6(2) of Regulation (EC) No 852/2004. However, this insinuation is considered by the CCA as the personal interpretation of the HFAA audit team. Such an interpretation cannot be deduced from the wording of Article 6(2) of Regulation (EC) No 852/2004 nor is it subject of any guideline of the EU Commission. Page: 1 report ref. response: Como ya se indicó durante la auditoría, en Galicia, la presencia de plantas hospedantes de Trioza erytreae es muy dispersa pués está fundamentalmente localizada en pequeños huertos y jardines de propietarios particulares. ismo, no hay producción de planta y, en general, la disponible en viveros procede de zonas de fuera de Galicia que están libres de la plaga. Los viveros de zonas libres que venden planta, restringen su comercialización a su entorno local por lo que los movimientos son muy reducidos. Nuestra experiencia parece indicar que la infección no se produce por el movimiento de planta, sino por la dispersión de la plaga de una zona infestada a otra próxima debido al vuelo de los adultos. En cualquier caso, está previsto publicar breve una resolución que actualice las zonas infectadas por Trioza eritreae. Así mismo se notificará, a todos los viveros y comercializadores de cítricos, las restricciones existentes en el movimiento de plantas hospedantes. Los interesados también podrán consultar las zonas infestadas, y las medidas a aplicar para evitar la extensión de la plaga a través de una página WEB. Page: 1 /02/2020 eport ref. restated_recommendation: The FASFC should ensure that the official control staff receive the necessary additional training and support, in line with the provisions of Article 5(4) of Regulation (EU) 2017/625, for carrying out their control duties in establishments producing ready-to-eat food in relation to the own-controls of FBOs to detect Listeria monocytogenes. Recommendation based on conclusion: 22. Associated findings 18 and 59.
response: An e-learning tool concerning Regulation (EU) No 2073/2005 with emphasis on Listeria monocytogenes (L.m) will be made available to the control staff. This tool will contain following parts: criteria for L.m., importance of growth characteristics of Ready to eat (RTE)-products in relation to growth of L.m., shelf life studies in general, shelf life studies for L.m. (based on literature, modelling, challenge testing, durability studies), environmental monitoring, analytical methods (incl. pooling). The official control staff will be made aware of the EU technical guidance document for shelf life studies for Listeria monocytogenes and the EU guidance document for the environmental sampling for Listeria monocytogenes. These documents are however currently under revision. As these new versions need to be included in the e-learning tool, the timeline for its completion will depend on the publication of the new version of these guidance documents. (see also audit General Follow-up, Reference Nr. 2020_6970, Recommendation 2019-6676-3)

response: In the designation Decree that the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport had initially published in December 2019, the veterinarians were designated for the provisions of Article 49 of Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/627. Paragraph 4 of that article states the checks in the field of hygiene measures during, among other things, refrigerated storage, transport and processing. These are tasks that COKZ performs. The auditors therefore rightly concluded that there was an overlap between the tasks of the designated veterinarian and the COKZ and, moreover, that the private veterinarians are also not qualified for these checks. This omission has since been remedied because the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport has officially published a revised designation Decree in the Staatscourant of 12 November, 2021. In this revised designation Decree, the veterinarians are only designated for the activities under Article 49, paragraphs 1 and 3. response: The veterinarians affiliated to SGD play a key role in ensuring that only milk from healthy animals is supplied. The independence of veterinarians is an important point of attention in the law and official regulations and in the other regulations by which the activities of veterinarians are safeguarded in practice. Assurance that veterinarians act free of conflict of interest in the performance of their official duties is therefore guaranteed by a combination of measures: 1. A veterinarian may only practice veterinary medicine if he/she is registered in the veterinary medicine register (Article 4.3 of the Animals Act). Independence of these veterinarians is guaranteed by the fact that they have a duty of care as included in Animals Act. Veterinarians can be held liable for non-compliance with this duty of care by way of disciplinary law. 2. Affiliation of veterinarians to an independent private assurance system, like SGD, also contributes to their independent position. response: he In general, Italy carries out an extensive national survey for Xylella fastidiosa, the largest in the Union in terms of inspections and analysis. All regions are involved s and the level of investigation is related to the characteristics of the region, the cultivated areas and the nursery activity. The official surveys are planned and carried out on the basis of national guidelines for monitoring, which define the main risk factors to be taken into consideration. In carrying out the investigations in free areas, the plant species most sensitive to several subspecies of the bacterium are more subjected to sampling for laboratory analysis. The large number of host plants listed in the regulation is not always represented in the various survey sites. Given the above, as part of the planning of the national Survey for 2022, currently in the final phase, a timely verification of the regional plans will be carried out, in order to verify that the main risk factors have been taken into consideration. Also for this purpose, a specific ministerial working group was officially set up, in which all the regions and CREA participate, with the aim of preparing and evaluate the national survey

response: Article 3(5) of Directive 2009/128/EC defines aerial spraying as the application of pesticides from an aircraft (plane or helicopter), the definition being reproduced identically in Article 1(5) of the amended Act of 19 December 2014 on plant protection products. The parenthesis containing the words `plane or helicopter' serves to explain the preceding word `aircraft'. The absence of an ellipsis or of the abbreviation `etc.' shows that the list is exhaustive. The concept of a drone, which is more recent, has its own meaning and cannot be likened to a plane or helicopter. Drones are therefore not affected by Article 9 of the Directive, which requires the Member States to prohibit aerial spraying. response: ion subject to amendment of legislation: Part of the WPM monitoring plan focuses on importers of risk material. These importers are selected on the basis of a customs lists of imported risk material. Imported consignments are usually delivered quickly at their destination. Directing these checks to imported consignments can only be put in place if their arrival is notified by a CHED-PP. Imposing such an obligation at national level would quickly result in a relocation of these imports to other Member States. Therefore, we propose to amend Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/2125 in such a way that monitoring of imported consignments is harmonised at EU level. Since the import requirements for WPM are harmonised at EU level, it would be logic that at all EU border control post product-origin combinations have the same chance to be checked.

response: Dne 23. 5. 2023 byli pracovníci, provádjící úední kontroly krmiváských provoz, proskoleni jak hodnotit plány HACCP, zejména cást týkající se identifikace nebezpecí provozovatelem. response: Dne 23. 5. 2023 byli pracovníci, provádjící úední kontroly krmiváských provoz, proskoleni ohledn pozadavk na uchováváni zálozních vzork provozovatelem, zejména jejich odbr a uchovávání vcetn pecetní. Inspektoi byli také proskoleni o nutnosti uvádt veskeré nedostatky zjistné pi kontrole do zpráv z tchto kontrol.

response: Dne 24. 5. 2023 byli pracovníci, provádjící úední kontroly krmiváských provoz, proskoleni ohledn úedního odbru vzork. Pokud jde o odbr konecných vzork doplkových látek a premix, byli pouceni o nutnosti uvést do protokolu o odbru vzorku veskeré odchylky od postupu odbru vzork podle naízení 152/2009. Dále byli pracovníci, provádjící úední kontroly krmiváských provoz, proskoleni, aby pouzívali vhodné dlice pi píprav konecných vzork krmiv, u kterých se pedpokládá nerovnomrné rozlození sledovaných látek. Tyto dlice jiz mají inspektoi na regionálních oddleních k dispozici. Page: 1 ns of report ref. restated_recommendation: To ensure that the procedures used by the official laboratories for the preparation of final samples result in the correct amounts being weighed out in line with the methods of analysis and that said samples are homogeneous. Legal basis: part A.1. of Annex II to Regulation (EC) No 152/2009. Recommendation based on conclusion: 44. Associated finding: 38.
response: Laborato postupuje v souladu s Annex II v Naízení komise (ES) c. 152/2009, kde není postup podrobn specifikován. Detailní popis je uvedený v Jednotných pracovních postupech. Vzhledem k tomu, ze auditor se snazil splnit vsechny body svého velmi ambiciózního programu, nebylo mozné tento bod ádn diskutovat a dolozit. Nicmén v pípad mykotoxin má opravdu uvedená studie nedostatky a bude provedena znovu. Studie bude doplnna o vliv velikosti navázky a v pípad poteby budou upraveny nase Jednotné pracovní postupy. Dokoncení studie bude do konce roku 2023. Vzhledem k tomu, ze jde o administrativní pochybení, výsledky a kvalita práce nebyly ohrozeny, pouze je poteba zlepsit stav dokumentace.

restated_recommendation: To ensure that analytical methods used for the testing of official feed samples are comprehensively characterised by relevant criteria. Legal basis: Article 34(4) of Regulation (EU) 2017/625. Recommendation based on conclusion: 44. Associated finding: 40.
response: Validacní parametry metod byly dostupné, ale pipoustíme, ze nebyly dostatecn dokumentované. Situace bude napravena tím, ze validace budou doplnny tak, aby byly kompletní a dále budou doplnny odkazy na parametry uvádné ve validaci konkrétních postup v Naízení komise (ES) c. 152/2009 nebo EN. Termín do konce roku 2023. Vzhledem k tomu, ze metody jsou validovány, výsledky a kvalita práce nebyly nedostatky ve validacní dokumentaci ohrozeny. Nedostatky v dokumentaci budou napraveny.

response: Dne 23. 5. 2023 byli pracovníci, provádjící úední kontroly krmiváských provoz, proskoleni ohledn prosetování nesouladu zjistného pi úedních kontrolách. Zejména byli proskoleni o nutnosti ve zprávách dostatecn dokumentovat, ze 1. byl urcen pvod/pícina a rozsah nesouladu, 2. byla pijata vhodná opatení, která nesoulad napraví 3. byla pijata vhodná opatení, která zabrání dalsímu výskytu takového nesouladu. Dále byli proskoleni o nutnosti uvádt v protokolech veskeré údaje nutné k identifikaci provozovatel odpovdných za krmivo tak, aby mohli být vsechny clánky etzce informovány v pípad zjistní nesouladu v úedním vzorku. Také byly stanoveny lhty, ve kterých musí být vzorek po odbru dopraven do laboratoe, a lhta od oznámení nevyhovujícího výsledku vedoucímu regionálního oddlení po setení nesouladu v krmiváském provozu, aby se zamezilo dalsímu prodlení. Bude obnovena supervize regionálních pracovis metodickým vedením, která povede k zajistní kvality a konzistence následných setení provádných regionálními oddleními. response: the All flocks that pose a significant risk of avian influenza are registered in our system. Only backyard flocks kept for own onsumption are not registered. Although these flocks are at risk of disease emergence, as there is minimal or no animal, person and vehicle movement in these flocks, they do not play a role in disease spread. In recent years, around 5% of outbreaks have been detected in backyard flocks. In the recent epidemic started in autumn 2023, we have seen that in the settlements where the virus has appeared in backyard flocks, it has not appeared in commercial flocks. In addition, in those settlements where it appeared in both commercial and backyard flocks, in all cases it appeared in backyard flocks after the outbreak in commercial flocks; but in no case the appearance in backyard flocks resulted in a commercial outbreak. It is also clear that HPAI has not spread from a backyard outbreak to other flocks. Only one backyard flock was affected in each affected municipality. response: that Reply SFA: We will ensure that we have a suitable procedure in place to monitor and verify that official controls in slaughterhouses are carried out effectively and appropriately in accordance with Article 5(1)(a) of Regulation (EU) 2017/625. Our aim is that this procedure will be in place by September 2025. Our plan is to establish a procedure for monitoring OV and OA on a regular basis. This will include a structured on-site supervision of the establishments to confirm that the OVs and OAs carry out the controls in the slaughterhouses correctly. The procedure will be risk-based and include both a quantitative and qualitative follow-up plan.

response: Reply SFA: f Earlier, before Regulation (EU) 2019/627 was introduced, the by SFA made the interpretation that delayed inspection could be carried out by Official Auxiliaries (OA). The staffing was adapted to be able to use both Official Veterinarian (OV) and OA for delayed inspection. The SFA has thus interpreted previous legislation as meaning that OA was allowed to carry out delayed inspection, who in many cases are just as competent to carry out PMI inspection as OV. In cases where an OV needs to make PM inspections of carcasses and/or organs for competence reasons, there is an option at the slaughterhouses to put those carcasses aside. The OV is then called to the slaughterhouse or the game handling facility. Adaptation to the conditions in Art. 13.1 of Regulation (EU) 2019/627 is taking place. This adaptation, which has been ongoing in recent years, has resulted in more OVs carrying out the delayed post-slaughter inspection. But this takes time given the situation we have in Sweden with the shortage of veterinarians, and it is expected to take several years before deferred inspections can be carried out by OV at all affected slaughterhouses and game handling facilities.
